card.name: Table or Figure numbers in labels
card.fires_on: The number (or the word Figure) right after the word Table at the start of a table caption in drug-label text. It comes after a sentence ending with a section cross-reference.

modes.label: Table number
modes.description: The digit after the word Table that begins a table caption.

modes.label: Figure label
modes.description: The word Figure starting a figure caption after a dosing instruction.

card.writes: It suppresses the word method and its variants, so it mostly blocks that word from appearing next.
card.plain: It marks the number in a table or figure caption in a drug label, such as Table 5.
